The DOI is **10.1515/THLI.2008.007**. The search tied this DOI to Croft & Poole's MDS article in *Theoretical Linguistics* 34(1), 2008, and it sits beside their companion piece "Inferring universals from grammatical variation." I could not load the article page to confirm the exact title, so that part rests on the search results alone. The shared note's alternatives are wrong: 10.1515/lity.2008.007 is a *Linguistic Typology* pattern, and this paper is in *Theoretical Linguistics*, while 10.1017/S0022226708005224 is a *Journal of Linguistics* DOI.

CONFIDENCE: 75
